pages.title: Hollowing Ward
pages.text: A trace of what the Void Wraith carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Hollowing for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
